Each book in the series is dedicated to a species or an animal group and contains 50 images and 50 curiosities 
Many other books to collect in the "Color and learn with Janelle - Animals" series 
Color and Learn with Janelle is an innovative series of educational coloring books for children, each designed to ignite curiosity and a love of learning through discovery. 
To prevent the subsequent image from getting stained (when using markers, for example), there is one image for each sheet. But on the back of the coloring page there is no empty space: children will find a scientific or historical-cultural curiosity (naturally adapted and simplified) linked to the theme of the book. 
This book is part of the "Color and learn with Janelle - Animals" series: many more animal themes available, check out the series! 
An ideal resource for teaching animal biology in school classrooms. Many other books to collect
